model.name: treeAdd.liveBroadcastEveryClient
model.description: add-folder/add-diagram creates the unit, MVC-live inserts the node in the tree (no reload), and broadcasts a cross-client ws event on the one ViewBus so EVERY connected client (incl a passive 2nd client that took no action) re-renders from the broadcast alone; asserted @390 post-broadcast on a second client, local/self emit inadmissible.
model.note: Architect wires Class/Method off the add-folder/add-diagram handler + ViewBus broadcast on build-go; tester owns the two-real-client @390 gate + the local-emit RED stub.
